items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Wingy... took us out of high school... we worked on Wednesday nights... at a ballroom called the Merry Garden Ballroom... Wingy Manone was playing in a place called The Brass Rail... I fronted the band.

ctx.x: mentioned Jess and what about Tesh. I mean, were you close with any of them?

Frank Tesch Teschemacher and I were close, we went to Austin High School together, and we had -- I was still playing the C-Melody saxophone and we had a sort of sax team and we would do -- were playing professionally now and getting as much as we could, we weren't really good enough to get -- to demand work, but Wingy Manone came to town and Wingy came right from New Orleans and he was the bandleader.
Wingy, you know, an interesting thing about him, he could get jobs, you know, he was a fairly good businessman, and terribly funny man, certainly one of the funniest men I have ever met.
